subject: general
question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A person, who travels in a spacecraft
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Astronaut'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here, the correct answer to substitute the given group of words should have a meaning similar to **'A person who travels in spacecraft'.**
 
• An **astronaut** is someone *who travels in space.* (अंतरिक्ष यात्री)
 
 
• **For Example** - There is not enough air in the space capsule to keep the three **astronauts** alive.
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word to replace the given group of words is **'Astronaut'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Astronaut'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the other words:
 
 
• **Cadet** means a young trainee in the armed services or police force. (सशस्त्र सेवाओं में एक युवा प्रशिक्षु)

 
 
• **For Example** - He entered the Navy as a **cadet**.
 
 
 
• **Ghetto** means the Jewish quarter in a city. (यहूदी बस्ती)
 
 
• **For Example** - His parents survived the Warsaw **ghetto**.
 
 
 
• **Voyeur** means a person who likes seeing and talking or writing about something that is considered to be private. (एक व्यक्ति जो दूसरों के व्यक्तिगत चीज़ें देखना पसंद करता है)
 
 
• **For Example** - Make sure you close the curtains at night, just in case there's a **voyeur** in the neighborhood.
